name: 2 Player Steal Brainrot
desc:
🔥  Collect rare Brainrots and Collect their Cash with your firend!
⭐ Defend your base with your friend from other teams trying to steal!
👣 Sneak into enemy teams bases and steal their BRAINROTs!

Make sure to play with your friend to fully experience the game!

[How to Play]
• Buy Brainrots that appear through the portal with your friend
• Add them to your collection to generate Cash (you and your friend can collect seperatly)
• Steal rare Brainrots and become the richest BRAINROT COLLECTOR ever
